optimizedContext.value:
# SQLite Graph Store
## Rules
- `SQLiteGraphStore` implements `GraphStore` through `better-sqlite3`, preserving `code-graph:graph-store`. Stable id `sqlite`; resolve native runtime only on `open()`; idempotent `close()`.
- Every synchronous SQLite query, mutation, transaction, schema/FTS/maintenance operation runs in one persistent dedicated `node:worker_threads` worker per open store, never host event loop. One worker/connection; no per-op workers/pooling; concurrent lifecycle calls share Promise.
- Worker owns connection, prepared statements, txns, schema, FTS, backend FS. Host/worker typed structured-cloneable request/result/error/progress DTOs use monotonic ids; no functions/native handles/class instances cross boundary. FIFO queue serializes lifecycle, maintenance, reads, mutations.
- Validate `maxPendingOperations >= 1`; default 256. Exceeding rejects `StoreOverloadError` without affecting accepted requests. `close()` rejects new work, drains within `drainTimeoutMs` default 5000ms, asks worker DB-close, force-terminates after deadline; unsettled reject `StoreWorkerError`. Await termination, no hard native wall-clock promise.
- Runtime config crosses as serializable `SqliteRuntimeDescriptor`; custom `modulePath` MAY select compatible binding; no public worker-path test override. Unexpected worker failure faults store, rejects outstanding `StoreWorkerError`; recovery explicit `close()` then `open()`, never restart. Close while opening owns final state.
- Bulk indexing worker session `sessionId`: only start creates session; missing/finalized staging/commit/rollback rejects. Host session states active/committing/rolling-back/finished bind lifecycle generation. Progress callback failures isolated. Closed-store recreate uses non-blocking host FS + generation rotation.
- Batch symbols/relations and `getFilesByPaths`/`getDocumentsByPaths`/`getSpecsByIds`/`getSymbolsByIds`: one logical batch one typed worker RPC; set-based predicates, deterministic bounded SQL parameter chunks, first requested identity ordering, dedupe, omit missing; empty input returns [] without RPC.
- Persist graph at `{configPath}/graph`, scratch `{configPath}/tmp`; DB/WAL/SHM only derived dirs, create on demand. Sole built-in/default backend absent `graphStoreId`; provides durable File/Document/Symbol/Spec/relation/meta state, atomicity, FTS identity search, bulk/reindex, traversal/reference/coverage/impact/hotspot/search/stats. Unreadable state recovers via full SQLite reindex.
- `recreate()` only closed: remove graph artifacts, rotate storage generation, leave no handle open. Only corruption/non-migratable schema maps to recoverable storage-open error; propagate other errors. Healthy force reindex uses open-store logical `clear()`, never delete/reopen.
- `clear()` atomic logical generation reset removes graph rows, observations, coverage, logical symbols/declarations, bindings, refs/resolution, latches, metadata, FTS; rollback preserves old generation. Persist compatible `storage.epoch`, expose on open; recreation rotation stales older providers.
- Adapter owns schema: File (source content snippets), Symbol, Spec, Document, Meta. Document: `path` PK, `configRelativePath`, `contentHash`, `content`, `workspace`. Relations: IMPORTS DEFINES CALLS CONSTRUCTS USES_TYPE EXPORTS DEPENDS_ON COVERS_FILE COVERS_SYMBOL EXTENDS IMPLEMENTS OVERRIDES; preserve COVERS_SYMBOL metadata.
- COVERS_SYMBOL needs committed logical-symbol target, not declaration row; persist logical symbols before validate. Missing source/target rejected + indexing diagnostic; preserve valid coverage across dedupe, reverse index, stats, worker serialization, GraphStore reads.
- FTS5: `symbol_fts` name/comment, `spec_fts` title/description/content, `document_fts` path/content. Keep MATCH discovery; sanitized OR tokens + shared lexical expansion; supplement identity hits FTS misses; never plain whole-query LIKE-only. SQL explicit ranking: exact canonical identity > strong non-exact identity > body/content; exact token > prefix > suffix > substring; real component > substring; higher expanded identity coverage wins; BM25 ranks remainder. Snippets/1-based lines source/FTS. File content not standalone searchable category.
- Each atomic mutation (`upsertFile()`, `removeFile()`, `upsertSpec()`, `removeSpec()`, bulk commit) entirely worker-side, one round trip; failure preserves committed state. Bulk staged bounded chunks; one atomic commit; merge reference chunks; progress cleanup/files/documents/symbols/specs/reference facts/observations/relations/search indexes; scratch only tmp.
- On open execute schema, verify/record version, prepare FTS; incompatible version MAY destructively rebuild. WAL/SHM implementation-only. Persist GraphStore logical-symbol/declaration/member/symbol-space/binding/provenance/coverage/construct/selection fields; indexed structured lookup; never parse/substr-rank canonical ids semantically. Maintain source substring index + bounded short-query fallback, set-based deterministic reverse coverage/traversal.
- Reference schema version `9`; every later schema change increments once. Incompatible data rejects normal reads; `graph index` destructively rebuilds, rotates `storage.epoch`, rebuilds search before ready. Persist observations/latches/VCS/unchanged facts; indexing run one transaction, bounded writes, endpoint validation, one commit, one semantic/content index rebuild.
## Constraints
- Infrastructure adapter; storage-agnostic consumers depend on `code-graph:graph-store`.
- SQLite layout, FTS, physical schema/versioning belong here.
- All SQLite artifacts rooted at `configPath`.
- Storage-agnostic CLI/use cases MUST NOT depend on SQLite specifics absent need.
